text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm North Flight.
It's a pleasure to meet you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that any material,
if polished enough, can truly shine."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I will continue to work hard.
So that one day, I may clothe myself in that light!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
